notes.title: [Complete]Major Update Patch Notes (June 27) (Updated)
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/13d35ac2a9e5dcb3651c0cb68e1f5c8930a30186.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello Super Soldiers,[/p][p][/p][p]We would like to extend our heartfelt thanks for the overwhelming support and sincere feedback you’ve shared throughout the past 7 days of CBT.[/p][p]This update was prepared based on your voices, aiming to refine core systems and provide a better gameplay environment. It also reflects the strong requests from many players who missed the original SUPER PEOPLE style our goal is to revive the pure excitement of a true shooter experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Please refer to the details of the update below. 👇[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png"][/img][/p][p][u][b]1. (New) First-Person Perspective (FPP) Mode Now Available[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]FPP mode is now available.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u][b]2. Complete Removal of normal Monsters[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Mid-bosses and major boss monsters will remain.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b][u]3. Restoration of Classic SUPER PEOPLE Field Looting System[/u][/b][/p][list][*][p]Weapons, gear, and items will now drop directly on the field.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Lv.1 and Lv.2 loot boxes will be removed; only Lv.3 (Gold) loot boxes remain.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/964c931fd15ca84342acf066046e5b715946036a.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]4. Shop Updates[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Added purchase favorites feature.   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/4c7ef3e86cb7bf90c3f019d602605c9814638382.png"][/img]  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Ultimate skill purchases have been removed from the shop.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/b4da6661572200e90818f167185535817231ac27.png"][/img]  [/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]5. Weapon Balance Adjustments[/b][/u] [/p][list][*][p][b]Reduced headshot damage multiplier:[/b][/p][list][*][p]AR: 2 -> 1.5[/p][/*][*][p]SMG: 1.8 -> 1.5[/p][/*][*][p]DMR: 2.5 -> 2[/p][/*][*][p]SR: 2.75 -> 2.5[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]PvP damage bonuses from specialized traits reduced[/b][/p][list][*][p]Brawler – PvP Damage Increase: 5, 7, 10, 12, 15, 20 → 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10[/p][/*][*][p]Veteran – PvP Damage Increase: 3, 5, 6, 7, 10 → 1, 2, 3, 4, 5[/p][/*][*][p]Sharpshooter – PvP Damage Increase: 3, 5, 6, 7, 10 → 1, 2, 3, 4, 5[/p][/*][*][p]Agile (Weapon) – PvP Damage Increase: 3, 6, 10 → 1, 2, 3[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/4c9c0d95b3f44316c5551159891af93d004a5263.png"][/img]  [/p][list][*][p][b]Adjusted rate of fire for semi-auto and 3-round burst weapons[/b][/p][list][*][p]DMRs – Reduced Single Fire Rate[/p][list][*][p]Delay between shots has increased[/p][/*][*][p]M1: 0.1s → 0.2s[/p][/*][*][p]SKS: 0.1s → 0.15s[/p][/*][*][p]Mini: 0.1s → 0.15s[/p][/*][*][p]WA2000: 0.1s → 0.15s[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]3-Round Burst ARs Adjusted Burst Interval & Single Fire Rate[/p][list][*][p]Time between bursts and single shots has increased[/p][/*][*][p]M16: Burst Interval 0.15s → 0.2s / Single Fire Delay 0.075s → 0.11s[/p][/*][*][p]G3: Burst Interval 0.15s → 0.22s / Single Fire Delay 0.085s → 0.115s[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u][b]6. Class Balance Changes[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Removed knockback effect from Shotgun Master’s Flashbang skill.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/95f60deb6ff7c6d574faa629aacd556172313232.png"][/img][/p][p][u][b]7. Level-Up Rewards Added[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Bonus gold will now be rewarded upon leveling up for enhanced growth incentives.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u][b]8. (New) Other Bug Fixes [/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Demolisher: Fixed an issue where the number of grenades reloaded per Shoulder Launcher cooldown was not working as intended.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png"][/img][/p][p]This major update is more than just a system tweak; it is a meaningful step to realign the identity and fun that SUPER PEOPLE aims to deliver.[/p][p][/p][p]Your gameplay and feedback during the final phase of this CBT will be extremely valuable as we shape the direction for the official launch.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you once again for staying with us until the end, and we sincerely hope for your continued support as SUPER PEOPLE prepares to soar again.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]◈ SUPER PEOPLE Dev. Team ◈[/p]

notes.title: [Complete] CBT Extension & Major Update Announcement (Updated)
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/4fcd436ac9edff94efb8b57c79991f93d536f390.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear Super Soldiers,[/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely thank you for the tremendous interest, feedback, and 
constant suggestions you’ve shared during the current CBT.[/p][p]Every single piece of feedback has been deeply meaningful to our development team, 
and we've been working as swiftly as possible to reflect your voices into tangible improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]Since before the CBT began, 
many of you have expressed a strong desire to revisit the traditional SUPER PEOPLE experience.[/p][p]After internal discussions, 
we've been preparing an alternate version that stays true to the original gameplay you loved. 
We are still actively working to bring this version as close to the classic experience as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]Now that a playable state is ready, we are extending the CBT to let you try both versions during the weekend.[/p][p]Your hands-on feedback will be essential in shaping the future direction of SUPER PEOPLE.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🗓️ CBT Extended Schedule[/b][/p][p]① US West (PDT): Until Sunday, June 29, 2025 at 8:00 PM[/p][p]② US East (EDT): Until Sunday, June 29, 2025 at 11:00 PM[/p][p]③ UTC: Until Monday, June 30, 2025 at 3:00 AM[/p][p]④ Korea (KST/UTC+9): Until Monday, June 30, 2025 at 12:00 PM
[/p][p][b]⏰ Scheduled Maintenance for Update[/b][/p][p]① US West (PDT): Thursday, June 26, 23:00 ~ Friday, June 27, 01:00[/p][p]② US East (EDT): Friday, June 27, 02:00 ~ 04:00[/p][p]③ UTC: Friday, June 27, 06:00 ~ 08:00[/p][p]④ Korea (KST): Friday, June 27, 15:00 ~ 17:00[/p][p]⚠️ Matchmaking will be disabled 30 minutes prior, and all players will be disconnected when maintenance begins.
[/p][p][b]🛠️ Major Update Details (Effective after June 27 maintenance)[/b][/p][p][b]1. Complete removal of normal monsters[/b][/p][p]  - Mid-boss and major boss monsters will remain.[/p][p][b]2. Restoration of classic SUPER PEOPLE field looting system[/b][/p][p]  - Weapons, gear, and items will now drop directly on the field.[/p][p]  - Lv.1 and Lv.2 loot boxes will be removed; only Lv.3 (Gold) loot boxes remain.[/p][p][b]3. First-Person Perspective (FPP) Mode Now Available[/b][/p][p]  - TPP mode has been closed and only FPP mode is now available.[/p][p][b]4. Removal of ultimate skill purchases from the in-game shop[/b][/p][p][b]5. Bonus gold rewards granted upon level-up to enhance progression[/b][/p][p][b]6. Balance Adjustment – Removed the knockback effect from Shotgun Master's [/b][b][i]Impact Flashbang[/i][/b][b] skill[/b][/p][p][b][strike]7. Other bug fixes and adjustments[/strike][/b][/p][p][/p][p]This update and CBT extension go beyond minor changes[/p][p]It reflects our serious intention to ask “What truly makes SUPER PEOPLE fun?”[/p][p]And to answer that question together with our players.[/p][p][/p][p]We encourage you to experience both versions of the game and share your honest thoughts on which direction feels more enjoyable.[/p][p]Your feedback will guide us in choosing a clearer and more confident path forward.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for staying with us until the end.[/p][p]We look forward to your continued participation and support.[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]The SUPER PEOPLE Dev. Team[/p]

notes.title: CBT Exclusive Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/9655dfffc888e1c41a8cba60b51282be4a5588f4.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, Super Soldiers!
Are you ready for the upcoming CBT?[/p][p] [/p][p]We’re working hard to prepare for the Closed Beta Test that will run for approximately 8 days starting next week.[/p][p]Due to increasing curiosity about SUPER PEOPLE, we’re excited to share the patch notes in advance so you can get a head start on what’s to come.[/p][p] [/p][p]This test brings sweeping changes to core systems: a new growth method, appearance of monsters, and the real-time in-game shop major updates that reshape the flow of combat itself.[/p][p] [/p][p]The feedback collected during this CBT will play a vital role in shaping the official release direction.[/p][p]Let’s dive into the details below. 👇[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/85a7934f679737b3f544295f4568b50482d99551.png"][/img][/p][p]🔁 [b]Core System Changes[/b][/p][p][b]● Growth System Overhaul[/b][/p][list][*][p]We have enhanced the farming system to support diverse strategies by integrating two key approaches: [b]engaging in combat with monsters or players, and collecting resources or loot boxes placed throughout the field.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Depending on the situation and your preferred play style, you can now [b]select and combine different farming routes[/b], offering greater depth and enjoyment in progression.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/4510ea55c046a0789c99ef06dfcbd784bcbac3fe.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/a7949cfab4d6fa7d0385385a8f5abfb517c3b760.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]🧰 New Loot Boxes Added[/b][/p][p]In addition to the existing structure where players could freely obtain various items and crafting materials across the entirety of Orb Island, the following elements have been newly added:[/p][list][*][p]Looting boxes of Levels 1 through 3 are now scattered throughout the map, allowing players to adjust their looting strategies based on the grade of each box.[/p][/*][*][p]Notably, high-level boxes have been designed with unique sound cues, making them easily identifiable and enabling players to leverage both visual and audio information for more strategic gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p]These changes allow for clearer planning of looting routes and enhance the risk-reward decision-making based on route selection.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/d4c0cd8afb02945e32775da0cc2b713cb8356653.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]🧤 Equipment Slot Expansion[/b][/p][list][*][p]Glove and footwear slots are added, introducing new defensive gear for hands and feet that influence combat efficiency.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/5b7daa8ba55db1eb13fd1efeebbc77cab6af2ba9.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/0d9293f8e4c44671a8150b93210bc2f285863932.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]● Monsters in Training Grounds[/b][/p][list][*][p]The training area now includes live monsters (excluding bosses) for skill and shooting practice.[/p][/*][*][p]A variety of monsters, excluding bosses, will appear randomly, providing an environment suitable for getting used to the feeling of actual combat.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/8096981912fc4bc23f603f8653b83b8d9005e1d3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]👁️‍🗨️[b] Full UI Overhaul[/b][/p][list][*][p]The skill UI and class selection interface have been restructured to reduce visual distractions during combat and to enhance clarity of information delivery.[/p][/*][*][p]We are already working on an even more advanced version of the UI, which is scheduled to be applied in the upcoming Early Access build. We appreciate your continued interest and look forward to showing you what’s next.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bb1644d517337fb19a13ec2e341ebb6410d2ec8e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]● Sliding Availability Adjustment[/b][/p][list][*][p]The sliding action, which was previously provided as a default character ability, must now be purchased and acquired through the in-game shop, except for certain classes.[/p][/*][*][p]This change is intended to ensure that not all classes have the same level of mobility from the start of battle. Some classes have been granted default access to sliding based on their roles and unique.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]🚨 Report & Penalty System (Test Version)[/b][/p][list][*][p]CBT introduces a report-based penalty system.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can report suspected cheaters; accuracy is validated via missions.[/p][/*][*][p]Accurate reporters are rewarded with trust grades (D to S), while false reporters are demoted to grade F.[/p][/*][*][p]This system is in testing and will evolve with your feedback.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/6168b3f7753e71a2176eb994ff7bf939dd7f17fd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🧬 [b]Class Rebalancing (CBT Adjustments)[/b][/p][p][b]● Default Outfit Auto-Equipped Per Class[/b][/p][list][*][p]When no outfit is equipped, the default class uniform will auto-equip ensuring clear class identity.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/927d9db02979c324ae09ad1d043bc1541a14d6c0.png"][/img][/p][p]🕊️[b] Resurrection System Test[/b][/p][list][*][p]Replacing specialized weapon skills, all classes will test a resurrection skill.[/p][/*][*][p]Solo: Resurrect with all items intact.[/p][/*][*][p]Duo/Squad: Resurrect with all items except those looted by allies.[/p][/*][*][p]Full squad death triggers team-wide revival.[/p][/*][*][p]A "Survival Supplies" spawns nearby post-revival.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]● Class-Specific Adjustments (Subject to Ongoing Tweaks)
[/b]⚠ Values subject to adjustment throughout CBT[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/be3d8c01b5e04f4eb75b3f52b206b4c2e40082ca.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/2758ed341cc2bffe98192385aa632096374f5d6a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]🔫 Class Rebalancing (CBT Adjustments)[/b][/p][p]⚠ Values subject to adjustment throughout CBT[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/f35ef45a476d146bc1e9a86224ab384d099261a0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]🧟 Monster & Farming System[/b][/p][p][b]● 15 Monster Types Spawn Across Orb Island[/b][/p][list][*][p]Defeating monsters drops gear, consumables, currency.[/p][/*][*][p]Monster list includes: SpiderQueen (Boss), GasZombie, StoneGolem, Skeleton, FatZombie, MuscleZombie, LurkerZombie, ChainSawZombie, Stoker, Ghoul, ShamanWerewolf, CannonBug, CannonPlant, BigCannon.[/p][/*][*][p]Regular monster drops: weapons, armor, attachments, mats, gold, ammo, recovery items[/p][/*][*][p]Boss monster drops: above + skills and premium currency[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/2dc2c8df07e56236f77125237038ae1b68ed360d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/aadad7159133588c3f96b0308f2558d60bb6716e.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]👣 Monster Location Tracking & Bounty System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bosses/mid-bosses are shown in real-time on the world map.[/p][/*][*][p]Timed bounties give enhanced rewards for killing high-value targets.[/p][/*][*][p]Bounty monsters are marked with visual emphasis on the map.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/d3e1b7b1023258cfaa7d6b386533f2023935690b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]🛒 In-Game Shop System (CBT Only)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Use gold earned in combat to purchase items and skills in real time.[/p][/*][*][p]Duplicate skills from your current class will not appear.[/p][/*][*][p]After purchased items spawn nearby after a short delay.[/p][/*][*][p]Sell equipped gear for additional gold.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/a3f5abd66133365337b10d0804645202eb54fb6a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]⚙ Specialization Options & Altar System[/b][/p][p][b]● Specialization Option System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Gear can now roll additional options based on its grade.[/p][/*][*][p]Test different builds and playstyles during CBT.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/64fa961324f1b0904319dc3de5a584e17bfc5ea9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]● Altar Buff System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Claim altars scattered across the map to receive time-limited buffs.[/p][/*][*][p]In Duo/Squad, one member’s capture gives team-wide buff.[/p][/*][*][p]Altars can be taken over buffs are revoked instantly.[/p][/*][*][p]Buff ends → altar resets → capture again to regain buffs.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/837617edb6efd6d67c8d64a0c2b6e45c3aa595b7.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This CBT build is a test environment, not a finished product.Features, stats, and balance may change throughout the test period.[/p][p] [/p][p]Your feedback will directly influence the development of the official release.
We’re looking forward to your active participation and thoughts.[/p][p] [/p][p]See you in the CBT, thank you![/p][p]◈ SUPER PEOPLE Dev Team ◈[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 📢(Update) Global CBT Schedule Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/97c90d0762cdb83f1a283e58f9973978990cc71d.png[/img]
[Notice Update]
※ Please note that the server opening will be delayed by approximately 30 minutes. We appreciate your understanding as we work to ensure a stable and smooth gameplay experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604384/bf7533b1f62aada470dcd06bda0cac57b8c95584.png[/img]
Dear Super Soldiers,
We are pleased to announce that the Global Closed Beta Test (CBT, Playtest) for Super People will begin on Thursday, June 18, PDT

Players from across the globe have expressed their excitement and anticipation for the return of Super People. In response to your continued support, we have been working tirelessly to reflect your feedback from the previous service, improve game content, and ensure greater stability—all of which were shared in the Director’s Letter.

We are fully committed to making this Global CBT a meaningful step toward delivering a better and more refined version of Super People.
[quote]■ Global CBT Schedule
[b]1. CBT Application Period: (UTC) May 22, 2025 (Thu), 1:30 PM – Until the end of the CBT
[/b]
[b]2. CBT Test Period
[/b]① (PDT): June 18, 2025 (Wed), 3:30 PM – June 26, 2025 (Thu), 6:00 PM
② (EDT): June 18, 2025 (Wed), 6:30 PM – June 26, 2025 (Thu), 9:00 PM
③ (UTC): June 18, 2025 (Wed), 10:30 PM – June 27, 2025 (Fri), 1:00 AM
④ (KST/UTC+9): June 19, 2025 (Thu), 7:30 AM – June 27, 2025 (Fri), 10:00 AM[/quote]
※ Please note that certain features or content in the CBT may be subject to change depending on internal conditions. If any adjustments are made, we will inform you in advance via official announcements.

More exciting news beyond the CBT will be shared soon.
We sincerely appreciate your continued interest in Super People and ask for your support as we move forward into this next chapter.

Thank you.
— The Super People Team
